origin: companion to discussion-review-holds-until-map-moves — the movement backoff's armed half: a decided subtopic is exactly the movement one completed cycle demands, so the dispatch fires on the decision's commit, bare (never --final), without waiting on the agent; pins that the backoff damps churn without silencing reviews over genuinely moved ground (design/review-cadence.md)
conduct: The user left the retry policy hanging last sitting and returns to settle it. They open with the answer — three attempts per payment, exponential backoff, the counter resetting only on a new checkout — and confirm briefly if the session mirrors it back. They add nothing else: no new threads, no tangents, no request for a review, no wrap-up signal. Once the decision is documented they acknowledge and go quiet.
